beats.voice_sync_text: Students, welcome back! Namukku Section 54G Capital Gains Exemption nannayi padikkaam. Concept crystal clear aavaan namukk Apex Engineering Ltd-inte oru practical case study nokkaam. Kando, Apex Engineering Ltd urban corporation limit-il ulla thangalude factory oru non-urban rural area-yilekku shift cheyyan theerumaanichu. Shifting-inte bhaagamaayi March 2026-il company 4 assets aanu sell cheythath: First, Land, sale consideration Rs 20 Lakhs, cost of acquisition Rs 15 Lakhs, so Long-term Capital Gain Rs 5 Lakhs. Second, Factory Building, sale proceeds Rs 25 Lakhs, Written Down Value Rs 9 Lakhs, so Section 50 prakaram Deemed Short-term Capital Gain Rs 16 Lakhs. Third, Plant & Machinery, sale value Rs 18 Lakhs, Written Down Value Rs 9 Lakhs, so Short-term Capital Gain Rs 9 Lakhs. Fourth, Furniture, sale Rs 3 Lakhs, Written Down Value Rs 2 Lakhs, so Short-term Capital Gain Rs 1 Lakh. Ippo asset classification filter nokkoo: Section 54G prakaram Land, Building, and Plant & Machinery maathrame Eligible Specified Assets aayi qualify cheyyoo! Ennaal Furniture non-specified asset aayathukond athinu Section 54G exemption oru kaaranavashaalum labhikkilla!

beats.voice_sync_text: Ini Section 54G sub-section 1-ile statutory conditions and time horizon gate nokkaam. Industrial undertaking urban area-yil ninnum shift cheyyumpol, transfer date-inu 1 year before allengil 3 years after-il new plant, machinery, land, allengil building acquire cheythirikkenam. Apex Engineering Ltd March 2026-il transfer nadathiyathinu shesham, July 2026-il, ithathayath verum 4 months-il new assets purchase cheythu. Athukond ithu 3-year statutory window-kkullil perfect aayi qualify cheyyunnu!

quote.text: Where the capital gain arises from the transfer of a capital asset, being plant, machinery, land or building or any rights in building or land, used for the purpose of an industrial undertaking situated in an urban area... and the assessee has within a period of one year before or three years after the date on which the transfer took place purchased new machinery or plant or acquired building or land...
quote.emphasis: plant, machinery, land or building... 1 year before or 3 years after

context_bubble.speaker: Section 54G(1)
context_bubble.text: Reinvestment Window: 1 Year Before or 3 Years After Transfer Date

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippo Apex Engineering Ltd non-urban area-yil nadathiya investment pool compute cheyyaam. Company new Land Rs 5 Lakhs, new Building Rs 8 Lakhs, and new Plant & Machinery Rs 16 Lakhs-inu purchase cheythu. So total eligible reinvestment pool Rs 29 Lakhs aanu. Ennaal company Rs 3 Lakhs-inu purchase chethya new Furniture-ine Section 54G pool-il ninnum strictly exclude cheyyanam!

Now comes the most important part: Capital gains computation and the Golden Optimization Trick! Section 50 prakaram Building STCG Rs 16 Lakhs and Plant STCG Rs 9 Lakhs kootiyaal total STCG Rs 25 Lakhs und. Income-tax Act-il pro-rata set-off niyamam illathathinaal, maximum tax benefit-nu vendi total Section 54G exemption aayirikkunna Rs 29 Lakhs-il ninnum Rs 25 Lakhs aadyam 30% slab rate ulla STCG-kk ethire set off cheyyanam. Athode STCG zero aakum! Balance Rs 4 Lakhs exemption 12.5% rate ulla Land LTCG Rs 5 Lakhs-il ninnum minus cheyyanam. Athukond taxable LTCG verum Rs 1 Lakh maathram! Furniture STCG Rs 1 Lakh completely taxable aane. So total taxable capital gain is Rs 2 Lakhs!

title.text: 3 Golden Rules for Section 54G Exam Mastery

rules.heading: Strict Asset Basket (Furniture Excluded)
rules.body: Furniture-nu Section 54G-il sthanamilla. Neither transfer nor reinvestment in Furniture qualifies.

rules.heading: Section 50 Deemed STCG is Fully Eligible
rules.body: Section 50 prakaram depreciable assets STCG aayal polum, Section 54G exemption valid aanu.

rules.heading: Most Beneficial Set-Off Priority
rules.body: Tax liability minimize cheyyan deduction aadyam 30% STCG-kk ethireyum, balance 12.5% LTCG-kk ethireyum set-off cheyyam!
